I started my driving journey as a complete beginner with absolutely zero experience behind the wheel, and I couldn't have asked for a better instructor than Moazzam.
From day one, Moazzam was incredibly patient, calm, and professional. Learning to drive from scratch can be incredibly stressful, but his teaching style completely eased my anxiety. He breaks down the basics—from steering control and mirror checks to complex maneuvers and road awareness—into simple, easy-to-understand steps. He never lost patience, even when I made classic beginner mistakes.
Thanks to Moazzam excellent guidance, structured lessons, and constant encouragement, my confidence on the road grew exponentially. If you are looking for an instructor who will build your skills from the ground up and genuinely cares about making you a safe, confident driver, book your lessons with Moazzam!

featured_reviews.name: Deep Nagpal
featured_reviews.review_text:
I learned driving from Moazzam and it was an excellent experience from start to finish. What sets him apart is his patience and calm demeanour — he never makes you feel nervous or rushed, which is so important when you're a beginner.
He starts from the absolute basics and progresses at your own pace, taking time to understand how comfortable you are before moving to the next step. He doesn't just teach you how to drive — he explains the functions of the car, road rules, and even tricky situations like uphill and downhill driving, which most instructors skip.
What I really appreciated was that he actively takes feedback, corrects your mistakes in a constructive way, and covers parking thoroughly too.
If you're looking for a driving instructor who is knowledgeable, patient, and truly invested in your learning — Moazzam is the one. Highly recommended!
